title: Past Passive
source: ELLLO (English Listening Lesson Library Online) - https://elllo.org/

conversations.transcript:
Man: When was this subway built?
Woman: It was built about 30
years ago.
Man: It still looks pretty new.
Woman: Yes, it was remodeled last year.
Man: Well, they did a nice job.
Woman: I’ll say.

stadium?
Woman: It was torn down last
year.

Woman: Yeah, a lot of damage
was done that night.
